# Bollampally, Srikanth Reddy

> Technical Founder of YTT Global. Full-Stack, DevSecOps, AI/ML and Agentic AI
> engineer with 12+ years turning legacy infrastructure into modern cloud
> systems and shipping machine learning built for production rather than
> demos. Now building and shipping own products at YTT Global, including a
> stealth healthcare startup.

## Background

- 12+ years across cloud infrastructure and production ML systems for
  enterprises including Duke Energy, USPTO, United Airlines, Cisco, CMS,
  Qualcomm, and the Georgia Technology Authority.
- Core capabilities: full-stack development (React, Next.js, Node.js,
  Python, Flask, FastAPI), cloud & DevOps (AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker,
  Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Ansible, Helm, ArgoCD), AI/ML (custom ML
  models, NLP, computer vision, MLOps, agentic AI, MCP, RAG), monitoring &
  SRE (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog), and databases (PostgreSQL,
  MongoDB, Redis, MySQL).
- Cut deployment time by 75% and held system uptime at 99.9% in
  production environments.

## Products and research

- Synapse: go-to-market console for SMBs, startups, and community leaders, https://synapse.ytt.global
- Vidya: multi-tenant school management platform for Indian K-12 schools, WhatsApp-first, English and Telugu
- Project-TEC: ed-tech initiative pairing students with live technical work and industry mentorship, https://ytt.global/project-tec
- HU-INT: containerized delivery platform for screened technical practitioners, https://ytt.global/huint
- kShield (live): security-focused tooling, https://ytt-global.github.io/kshield/
- Axon: CRM for SMBs and solo operators (early build)
- Vahk: real-time voice agent (in development)
- DataFuse: open-source analytics platform, Python ingestion plus DuckDB WASM OLAP (in development)
- YTT Payments: shared payments backbone for YTT products (in development)
- Jodhpur Sweets: quick-commerce app for Indian sweets, Flutter and FastAPI, Razorpay UPI
- QGA Cancer Therapeutics (research POC): quantum genetic algorithm (NVIDIA CUDA-Q) for multi-drug cancer therapy selection, https://ytt-global.github.io/qga-cancer-therapeutics/
- IDP (MVP): document intelligence engine using hand-written TF-IDF and cosine-similarity ranking, https://github.com/mesrikanthreddy/Search-AI
- Cross-Border Patient Portal (in design): patient portal for a stealth healthcare startup, designed around HIPAA, GDPR, and DPDP requirements, with an end-to-end encrypted document docket
